# info-structure: `Listing`

The `data` payload of `openreadout info FILE --view structure --json`, inside the [envelope](envelope.md).

Output of `info --view structure`.

JSON Schema: [`docs/schema/info-structure.schema.json`](https://github.com/openreadout/openreadout/blob/main/docs/schema/info-structure.schema.json) · also printed by `openreadout self schema info-structure`.

## Fields

| field | type | always present | description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `path` | `string` | yes | The input file. |
| `format` | `string` | yes | Format id of the input file. |
| `entries` | array of [`LsEntry`](#lsentry) | yes | Container elements in file order. |
| `acquisition` | [`Acquisition`](#acquisition) or `null` |  | Present when the file is not finished: still being written (`in_progress`) or stopped before the end (`interrupted`). See `book/src/guides/lab-shares.md`. |

## Types

### LsEntry

One row of `info --view structure`: a structural element of the container.

| field | type | always present | description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `kind` | `string` | yes | `image`, `plane`, `segment`, `chunk`, `block`, `attachment`, `metadata`, `pyramid-level`, ... |
| `name` | `string` | yes | Element name (an id, a chunk name or a path inside the container). |
| `offset` | `integer` (uint64) or `null` |  | Byte offset of the element in the file, when it has one. |
| `size` | `integer` (uint64) or `null` |  | Size of the element in bytes, when known. |
| `image` | `integer` (uint32) or `null` |  | Which image this element belongs to, if any. |
| `details` | any JSON |  | Format-specific details (JSON), omitted when empty. |

### Acquisition

`acquisition` in `info`, `info --view structure`, `check` and `check --planes`: present only for
files that are not finished. See `book/src/guides/lab-shares.md`.

| field | type | always present | description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `state` | [`AcquisitionState`](#acquisitionstate) | yes | `in_progress` or `interrupted`. |
| `complete_planes` | `integer` (uint64) | yes | Planes whose data is entirely on disk. |
| `expected_planes` | `integer` (uint64) or `null` |  | Planes the finished file will hold, when the metadata written so far says so. |
| `modified_ago_s` | `number` (double) | yes | Seconds since the file (or the newest member of a directory store) was modified. |
| `window_s` | `number` (double) | yes | The live window used for the decision, in seconds. |
| `missing` | array of `string` | yes | Structures written at the end of an acquisition that are absent. |
| `tail_bytes` | `integer` (uint64) | yes | Bytes after the last complete unit (a unit still being written). |
| `evidence` | array of `string` | yes | The observations behind the decision. |

### AcquisitionState

Whether an incomplete file is still being written.

| value | meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `"in_progress"` | Recently modified and missing only what is written last: still acquiring. |
| `"interrupted"` | Missing what is written last, but unchanged for longer than the live window: the acquisition (or a copy) stopped before the end. |
